Subject: Invoice 2026-487 — payment options and requested timing

Hi Arjun / Sarah,

Following up on Invoice 2026-487 (attached proforma) — total USD 59,400. We want to confirm your preferred payment path so we can lock the provisioning window on our end. Options we can accept today:

- ACH (US) — standard processing (2–3 business days)
- Wire (same-day if initiated before your bank cutoff)
- Virtual card (single-use) — instant but processing fee applies to the payer

If you can confirm payment method and ETA by EOD Friday (10/09), we can preserve the onboarding slot and apply the standard onboarding credits. If you need a PO/proforma with tax breakdown for your AP team, see attached proforma_invoice_2026-487.pdf — happy to update with Meridian’s VAT/withholding fields if you send your billing entity details.

If ACH or wire, please indicate whether Meridian will include remittance reference INV-2026-487 and whether you require a copy of Redwood’s W-9 (US) — we can loop in Finance.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- If Meridian clears payment by COB 10/09, authorize standard onboarding credits (per pricing sheet).

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — we can move forward. A few quick points from AP:

1) We will pay by wire. Can you send wire instructions and the beneficiary name exactly as it should appear on the transfer? Our bank requires bank name, ABA, SWIFT (for correspondent), beneficiary account and address.

2) Meridian needs a VAT-compliant invoice and the proforma with the legal billing entity to raise a PO. Please include any tax registration numbers on the invoice.

3) We expect funds to be released on 10/09; if your wire instructions arrive today we should hit that date. If we encounter a cut-off issue we'll fallback to ACH on Monday morning (10/12).

Also, please confirm whether Redwood will accept a partial wire (50%) this week and balance next week if necessary — AP prefers to avoid split payments but asked if it’s an option.

Arjun Rao
Head of Procurement, Meridian Labs
arjun.rao@meridianlabs.com | +1 (212) 555-3301

Arjun — great, thanks for the quick reply.

Attached are the wire instructions (wire_instructions_Meridian.pdf) and an updated proforma with a VAT line item. A few clarifications below:

- Wire details: beneficiary = Redwood Inference, Inc.; account ending in ••87; Bank: First West Bank; ABA: 026009593; SWIFT: FWBBUS33. Use reference INV-2026-487 so Finance can match remittance.
- Partial wire: we can accept 50% now and 50% within 7 calendar days, but please add a note in the funds transfer message that the remainder will follow by 10/16. We’ll mark the account as provisioned once the first tranche clears; full onboarding is gated on full payment completion.
- VAT invoice: Kimberly (cc’d) will issue the final invoice with your billing entity + tax ID once you confirm the exact legal name and VAT ID to include.

Next steps:
1) Arjun — confirm you’ve received the wire PDF and whether Meridian will send full or partial wire today.
2) Sarah — if you can confirm Meridian’s billing entity name and VAT/Tax ID in reply, Kimberly will issue the VAT invoice the same business day.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded next week.

Rishi Malhotra
